about: The one owner of the site's tool pictures and videos (#414): each shot's slot (a tool card of site/index.html), size, text alternative, caption and the steps that take it again. scripts/site_capture.py takes the shots on the Mac with the tablet over inkctl, on test notes under Note/Tests/ with synthetic content only; scripts/site_media.py writes each card's media block from the files present in site/media/ and checks them in the site gate.

shots.alt: A Supernote test page with a hand-drawn triangle, circle and arrow turned into clean shapes.
shots.caption: Smart Shapes: hold the pen still at the end of a stroke and it becomes a clean shape.

steps.hand: Draw a triangle, a circle and an arrow, holding the pen still at the end of each, then press Enter.

shots.alt: Video: a handwritten word on a Supernote test page becomes typed text right after it is written.
shots.caption: Real-Time Text: the word «casa» is written by hand and becomes typed text at its place, with no lasso.

steps.hand: Turn Real-Time Text on, then press Enter; the recording starts and you write «casa» on the page.

shots.alt: A Supernote test page with the handwritten word «apple» lassoed and a picture of an apple inserted beside it.
shots.caption: Insert Image: lasso a handwritten word and a picture of it lands on the page.

steps.hand: Wait until the picture is on the page, then press Enter.

shots.alt: Video: the handwritten word «apple» is lassoed and Insert Image places a picture of an apple on the page.
shots.caption: The word «apple» is lassoed, Insert Image is pressed in the lasso menu, and a picture of an apple appears beside the word.

shots.alt: The Image Editing window on a Supernote, showing a lassoed photo of an apple with its editing buttons.
shots.caption: Image Editing: lasso a picture to make it readable on e-ink, crop it or remove its background.

steps.hand: Lasso the apple photo, press Image Editing in the lasso menu, then press Enter.

shots.alt: The Device Link window on a Supernote, ready to send the open test page to a nearby device.
shots.caption: Send Page: the open page goes to an iPhone or a Mac on the same network.

steps.hand: Press Send Page in the toolbar and wait until the Mac is listed, then press Enter.

shots.alt: Video: a Supernote test page is sent to a Mac, then a picture sent from the Mac lands in the open note.
shots.caption: The open test page is sent to the Mac, then a picture sent from the Mac is received into the same note.

steps.hand: Open Receive in Device Link, then press Enter; the recording starts and the Mac sends the picture.

shots.alt: Account Sync's settings on a Supernote, with every account off and a Connect button on each row.
shots.caption: Account Sync: every account stays off until you connect it.

steps.hand: Open Account Sync's settings with no account connected, then press Enter.

shots.alt: The Handwriting Language app on a Supernote, listing the installed recognition languages with one selected.
shots.caption: Handwriting Language: one tap switches the recognition language of the whole tablet.

steps.hand: Open Handwriting Language from the app list, then press Enter.

shots.alt: The Ink Notebook Editor window on a Mac, showing a page of a test notebook with handwriting.
shots.caption: Ink Notebook Editor: a Supernote notebook opened on the Mac.
